description: Northline capacity memory: latency budgets, error budgets, storage units, retention, gateway timeouts, retries and the Search 2.4 rollout. Evidence is the SLO policy, a 2026-09-18 capacity note, a 2026-03-02 retention plan, ADR-030, the superseded ADR-018 and the search release notes. Hard parts: milliseconds against seconds and minutes, GB against GiB, percent paraphrases, a 105-day gap stated only as two dates, an incorrect production version, search versus billing scope, and modality (must not, only if) and dated rule adoption.
